test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/unit/test_feedback_submit_validation.py
@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import pytest
+
+from langfuse.api.feedback.client import FeedbackClient
+from langfuse.api.feedback.types.feedback_target_type import FeedbackTargetType
+
+
+class DummyResponse:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.data = "ok"
+
+
+class DummyRawClient:
+    def submit(self, **kwargs):
+        return DummyResponse()
+
+
+def make_client():
+    # Bypass __init__ to avoid needing a real ClientWrapper
+    client = FeedbackClient.__new__(FeedbackClient)
+    client._raw_client = DummyRawClient()
+    return client
+
+
+def test_feedback_submit_empty_target_raises():
+    client = make_client()
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        client.submit(
+            target_type=FeedbackTargetType.SKILL,
+            target="",
+            feedback="test feedback",
+        )
+
+
+def test_feedback_submit_success():
+    client = make_client()
+    result = client.submit(
+        target_type=FeedbackTargetType.SKILL,
+        target="valid-target",
+        feedback="test feedback",
+    )
+    assert result == "ok"
